new.evidence: Midday bulk times leave 11.7071–13.5622 kg. 99% removal takes 0.31031–5.34571 h under held weather; these are not guaranteed operating times.
new.needed_to_ground: Replace complete-drying labels with potential-rate equivalents, integrate local inventories and the water threshold required for takeoff; measure full curved-panel drying.

new.evidence: Sphere-correlation morning model condenses on 36.545% of the hull while the full-wet hull integral is positive.
new.needed_to_ground: Resolve wet/dry areas, runoff and time-varying sun/weather before using a morning waiting time.

new.topic: Pond orientation and missing placement inputs
new.evidence: Named 55.1496/171.4239 kg node/bay totals are not reproduced. Explicit independent triangular geometry gives 110.7660/117.0939 kg.
new.needed_to_ground: Publish vertices, oriented bays, placement coordinates/seed and quadrature; evaluate the actual 500-face frame, including fivefold vertices. Confirm by a full-size bay test. Do not promote either surrogate to a hull prediction.

new.evidence: 301-division equal-point quadrature reproduces k=1.017367; continuous area gives 1.007250. Directional dry angle reaches 16.5463 degrees, and the filed profile is positive above 14.
new.needed_to_ground: Converge area-weighted integration and trace the complete tilt/drain/re-capture path rather than claiming all ponds empty after a single 14-degree hull tilt.

new.evidence: 65–465 h reproduces a mass/initial-area/flux calculation. Area shrinks as water level falls.
new.needed_to_ground: Integrate changing pond area and use liquid-water optical properties. Retain the operational finding that passive pond drying is slow.

new.evidence: At R10 the same thickness/density assumptions give 32.6726–94.2478 kg and USD 16861.9274, versus 16.3363–47.1239 kg and USD 8430.9637.
new.needed_to_ground: Count bottom and top coats; measure cured areal mass. Obtain a top-coat quote. Resolve the retailer heading 50 gallons versus descriptive 55-gallon drum, and include application cost.

new.evidence: Measured acrylic 0.35±0.08 g over 80×80 mm equals 54.6875±12.5 g/m². The 54 g/m² calibration is a rounded mean. Rain factor 0.08/0.054 is a cross-material scenario, not a statistical upper bound.
new.needed_to_ground: Measure advancing/receding angles, population/coverage, water uptake and retained load on actual finishes; include underside rain and drainage across the equator.

new.evidence: All RETAIN finishes inherit mirror emittance .8 for dew. The dry-optics reference night reaches 272.9766 K locally. Sphere convection is extrapolated to large Reynolds numbers.
new.needed_to_ground: Measure wet optics and transfer; model liquid/ice phase and both hull faces. Keep the whole calculation provisional.

new.evidence: P3 dew totals reproduce only when all deposited water is retained over the top 14-degree cap, independently of bay orientation.
new.needed_to_ground: Document that inferred cap convention and replace it with each bay’s remaining capacity and drainage connection.

new.evidence: P2 capacities are for the mirror, actual joining, bake, cure in global/crimp, no 5% joining floor. They are reused for other finishes without changing their thermal/coating bill.
new.needed_to_ground: Recompute capacity after any actual coating, heater, weather or joining change. Add pond hydrostatic loading and installed failure qualifications when resolving the structural model.

new.evidence: Film-mass rejection applies at R10, not at R30 ISA. Floor-scaled shelter cost has no adequate height or system quote; air-knife costs and residual water are absent.
new.needed_to_ground: Compare complete energy, wiring, ground equipment, availability and shelter bills before claiming a least-cost operating system.

new.evidence: FAO example 19 is grass reference evapotranspiration with surface resistance and ground heat storage. A sun-facing wet hull element is a different boundary-value problem.
new.needed_to_ground: Keep 0.63 versus about 0.72 kg/m²/h as a plausibility comparison, not validation of hull drying.

inherited_owner.needed_to_ground: Weigh a full-scale curved panel with each finish after rain and dew at 0-90 deg and inverted.

inherited_owner.needed_to_ground: A full-size sagged bay with members: pond mass against tilt, and the spill angle.

inherited_owner.claim: P3's OD4/white protection outer layer has no sourced wettability; paint-like and FEP-like bounds are used.
inherited_owner.needed_to_ground: Contact angles of the actual protection layer.

inherited_owner.needed_to_ground: Areal mass, optics and life of the coating on the finish.
